subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should OpenClaw accept this opt-in `iterationBudget` config block plus the new agent-core and harness enforcement hooks as the permanent public API for loop safety?
rationale: The code is coherent and proven, but automation cannot decide final config naming, defaults, summary semantics, or plugin harness compatibility policy for a new public surface.

options.title: Accept Current Opt-In Contract
options.body: Land the PR after maintainer review confirms the names, defaults, summary behavior, and unsupported-harness fail-closed semantics are intentional.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Keep the runtime work but rename or gate the config/API as experimental until plugin and operator expectations are settled.

options.title: Defer To Design Follow-Up
options.body: Pause or close this branch and move the budget semantics into a narrower maintainer-owned design issue or replacement PR.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Opt-In Contract
recommendation.body: Land the PR after maintainer review confirms the names, defaults, summary behavior, and unsupported-harness fail-closed semantics are intentional.
